extensions.name: Auralix Music Downloader
extensions.description: Starter listing for downloading audio files from direct links and other sources that explicitly permit downloading. Supports MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC and M4A when provided by the source.

extensions.name: Auralix Video Downloader
extensions.description: Starter listing for downloading non-DRM video files from direct links and other sources that explicitly permit downloading. Supports MP4 and WebM; available resolutions depend on the source.
